scene_prompt: Modern classroom. Stubborn child turns face away from kind teacher and continues trying to push a VERY LARGE square wooden block onto a TINY round hole in a horizontal shape board. Large square block is THREE TIMES diameter of tiny round hole, its bottom remains entirely ABOVE board surface, all four bottom corners plainly rest on solid wood AROUND small hole. No part enters hole. Side front view clearly shows block bottom flat against board, tiny circular hole visible just in front of block as child misaligns and presses. Teacher points to huge square opening at other side of board, and classmate correctly fits another matching square block in square opening. Clear rejecting obvious explanation, not learning difficulty. Child frowning chin turned away, ears covered only metaphorically through turned head, both hands remain correctly on block. No text labels letters numbers brands watermarks. 3:2 graphite watercolor colored pencil ivory paper.
